title: R1250RT Luxury Tourer (Adventure Spec)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the BMW Motorrad R1250RT Luxury Tourer (Adventure Spec) is born on the race grid to deliver uncompromised high-speed aerodynamic downforce. At its heart lies a 1250cc powertrain delivering 154 HP and 123 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 228 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Aggressive Forward Tuck posture paired with a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 19.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
